whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Foodiegram,

I noticed your cafe has 132 reviews on Buddh Marg in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page for local food lovers.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, aur instant location navigation integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://foodiegram-demo.arclane.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Foodiegram Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe (Foodiegram on Buddh Marg, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a digital menu showcase, table reservation, and direct WhatsApp ordering for your customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual dishes aur pricing setup karke ise live kar sakte hain."
